tours.name: Dolphin Watch & Snorkel Combo
tours.description:
##Dolphin Watch & Snorkel Trip Combo

•	Witness local dolphins in their natural habitat
•	Snorkel Along the Shallow Backcountry
•	Includes snorkel gear and professional instruction
•	Complimentary beer, wine, sodas & water
•	Dolphin SMART-certified company

Come aboard Fury’s Key West Dolphin Watch and Snorkel Tour for a journey to observe the grace and beauty of our resident Key West dolphins. Take our fast catamaran on an adventure into the shimmering turquoise waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Fury is part of “Dolphin SMART,” a program that protects and promotes the responsible observance of dolphins. Our experienced crew will share some fascinating facts about the estimated 200 local dolphins. Together, we’ll responsibly watch dolphins as they swim, play, feed and do what comes naturally. Next, we’ll head to the Key West wildlife refuge where we’ll snorkel along the shallow back country. See sponges, coral, tropical fish and more as the warm Florida Keys sun illuminates the sky. You don’t have to be an expert swimmer, because our crew will provide you with guidance and top-of-the-line gear including mask, fins, snorkel and a float if you wish. Enjoy complimentary sodas, water, cold beer and chilled wine on our morning and afternoon trips or champagne and the perfect view of our world famous sunset on our sunset combo trip.

##Double Dip  

•	Snorkel North America’s Only Living Coral Reef
•	Enjoy approximately 1-1.5 Hours of Snorkeling, at 2 Different Locations
•	Includes Snorkel Gear & Professional Instruction
•	Features Convenient Stairway to the Sea
•	Complimentary Beer, Wine, Soda & Water

What’s better than snorkeling in Key West? Doing it twice! Climb aboard Fury’s fast catamaran and embark on a journey that explores Key West’s underwater marvels. During our 3-hour Key West snorkeling trip, you’ll get the chance to snorkel the reef in two different locations. Fury’s power catamaran was built for speed and comfort. It’s the quickest way to get to the reef, so you can spend less time traveling and more time snorkeling. Once at the reef, you’ll be given top of the line snorkel gear including a snorkel, mask, fins and a snorkel vest. You’ll also get some professional tips and guidance on how to best snorkel and enjoy your experience. After meeting some of our most popular residents - the colorful marine species that inhabit the reef - we’ll transport you to another ideal location on the reef for more snorkeling.

**ALL PADI COURSES PURCHASED WITH SILENT WORLD DIVE CENTER ARE NONREFUNDABLE - NO EXCEPTIONS!**

- 2 Days

##About
The PADI Open Water Course consists of **three main phases**:

- **5 Online Knowledge Development sections** (eLearning) to learn the basic principles of scuba diving
- **Confined Water session** to learn how to use your equipment and practice your skills in a controlled environment
- **4 Open Water Dives** to apply the skills you learned during the confined session and to explore!

- If you **do not show up for your reservation**, you will be billed for the full price of the course per person that was reserved. **To reschedule**, a **$250 fee** will be charged for not showing up to the scheduled course date or making changes the same day of the scheduled course.

*Explore Key Largo's Shallow Reefs & Wrecks with Silent World Dive Center on our Phoenix Boat!*
_______

##About
The Phoenix offers unforgettable diving on the world’s 3rd largest barrier reef and Key Largo’s famous shallow wrecks. Our sites are within the John Pennekamp Coral Reef State Park, the first undersea park in the United States - located inside the Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary.

- Small group guides or private guides **available for hire**.

- Scuba dive gear **rentals available**.

- **Scuba Divers (tanks & weights):** $105 + tax
- **Snorkelers:** $85 + tax
- **Passengers:** $65 + tax

###Information on Minors (Under 18 years old)
- **ANYONE** who is under the age of 18 years old **MUST** be accompanied by an adult. 
- **IF NOT,** parents/guardians may **hire a guide** for their minors.
*This is based on availability, so please call Silent World at (305) 451-3252 for more information and to book.*

##Please Note:

- Divers must have **proof of certification**, and have **dove within the past 12 months**.

- *18 hours are **REQUIRED** after scuba diving before flying.*

4.5 Hours

##About

**Coral Restoration Dive Program with Silent World**

Join Coral Restoration Foundation & Silent World Dive Center at Carysfort Reef, our showcase restoration site and home of our second largest Coral Tree™ nursery.

##How to start:

You can start now by reserving your spot through our online booking system. 

##What are the requirements for the Coral Restoration Foundation Dive Program?

- You must have **at minimum the PADI Junior Open Water Diver Certification**
- The **minimum age to dive or snorkel in the program is 10 years old.**
- For **divers under the age of 18 a parent guardian must be with them during the dive at all times**
- **The classroom session at Coral Restoration Foundation the morning of the dive trip unless you have done the program within the last 9 months.** If this is the case you can register just for the dive portion in the afternoon.
- You **MUST** have dove within **12 months.** 
*(If not we can provide a refresher program to bring your Scuba Certification current during the dive trip with Coral Restoration Foundation. If this is the case please contact Silent World Dive Center to book via phone or email.)*

##What will your schedule look like?

Classroom Session & Hands-on training starts at **8:00 AM at the Coral Restoration Foundation™ Exploration Center** at **5 Seagate Boulevard Key Largo.**

All Coral Restoration Foundation™ Restoration Adventure dive programs begin with a morning of education, which includes a presentation about CRF’s restoration work and mock hands-on land practice of restoration techniques. 

There will be a break for lunch before **check-in at the dive shop at 12:15 PM.**

In the afternoon, *weather permitting*, we will put that practice to work by either working to maintain one of our coral nurseries, monitoring coral for survivor-ship and/or coral out-planting!
 
*The activities we do can not be guaranteed as they are dictated by the day’s weather conditions and what work needs to be accomplished!*

This program incurs the dive operator cost (booking cost & needed equipment rental cost), However a **$50 donation per person is required** to the Coral Restoration Foundation™.

## About

Get ready for a sweet and sunny adventure on a donut tour through Key West, where island vibes meet irresistible treats. Start at the beloved Glazed Donuts on Eaton Street, where small-batch, gourmet donuts fly off the shelves—so get there early before they sell out! tours.name: Deep Sea Half Day
tours.company: The Poppa Wahoo Collective DBA Poppa Wahoo
tours.durationText: 4 hours on the reef: grouper, snapper, kingfish.
tours.description: Islamorada’s half-day offshore charter runs about four hours aboard Poppa Wahoo, a big, stable 55-foot sportfishing yacht with a shaded deck, air-conditioned cabin and a real bathroom. The reef edge and nearby wrecks lie minutes from the dock, so lines are in quickly and the crew focuses on grouper, snapper, kingfish and whatever the season is serving. Morning departures (around 7 am) give the calmest seas; afternoons suit late sleepers and wrap with a sunset ride home. Captain and mate coach every step, clean the catch at the dock, and bag fillets for dinner.
highlights: Fast run to productive water; family-friendly length; professional crew; catch cleaned for dinner
